subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should interrupted subagent completion announce turns be persisted and reconciled as non-running killed delivery turns, while always running tool-free across CLI, embedded, and Codex native paths?
rationale: The patch changes persisted session recovery semantics and the internal tool boundary for delivery turns, which are compatibility and security-boundary decisions that should be accepted by owners before merge.

options.title: Accept PR semantics after checks
options.body: Land once check-lint and the current-main merge result are clean if maintainers accept killed-session reconciliation and tool-free announce delivery.

options.title: Use a different terminal state
options.body: Update the recovery patch if killed is not the desired persisted terminal state for aborted delivery-only announce runs.

options.title: Pause for a broader delivery model
options.body: Defer this PR if maintainers want one generic model for all inter-session delivery turns instead of an announce-specific marker.

recommendation.title: Accept PR semantics after checks
recommendation.body: Land once check-lint and the current-main merge result are clean if maintainers accept killed-session reconciliation and tool-free announce delivery.
